title: A Simple K-Beauty Routine in Four Steps
description: Four Korean skincare picks that cover essence, serum, moisturizer and sunscreen, each under $30, with what the listing says and who should skip each.
dek: Essence, serum, cream, sunscreen. A short routine built from four picks.
hook: A short routine is easier to keep. These four picks cover the order most routines follow: essence, serum, moisturizer, then sunscreen in the morning.
I did not test these. I read each listing and use only what it says, so check the details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is or what size it is.
Anything that needs tools, wiring or a permanent change, for the renter and small-space guides.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and its size or capacity.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: If you only buy one, make it the sunscreen. Add the essence and cream next, and the serum if you want a fourth step.
hero_alt: A bright bathroom vanity with a marble tray of unlabeled skincare bottles, a linen towel and a plant

picks.name: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence, 100ml
picks.alt: Illustration of a bottle of Korean snail essence on a bathroom tray
picks.limit: Skip it if you are sensitive to snail-derived ingredients
picks.why: A lightweight 100 ml essence with 96% snail secretion filtrate, used after cleansing. It is known for a quick-absorbing, slightly bouncy texture.
picks.con: Skip it if you are sensitive to snail-derived ingredients, and patch test any new product first.

picks.name: Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Serum, 1.01 fl oz
picks.alt: Illustration of a small pink serum bottle on a marble tray
picks.best_for: A serum step between toner and moisturizer
picks.why: A lightweight serum with PDRN and peptides. It goes on after toner and before moisturizer.
picks.con: Check the size on the listing. It is a 1.01 fl oz bottle.

picks.name: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream, 2.02 fl oz
picks.alt: Illustration of a jar of light moisturizing cream
picks.best_for: A light moisturizer that layers under other skincare
picks.limit: PDRN on the label is salmon DNA
picks.why: A 2.02 fl oz cream with PDRN (salmon DNA) and hyaluronic acid on the label. The texture is described as lightweight and non-greasy, which suits layering.
picks.con: Check the ingredient list for anything you avoid. Patch test first.

picks.name: RELIEF SUN Korean Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++, Rice & Probiotics
picks.alt: Illustration of a sunscreen tube on a bathroom shelf
picks.best_for: The last morning step, every day
picks.why: A daily face sunscreen rated SPF50+ PA++++, with rice extract and probiotics on the label. The listing positions it as a lighter-feel option compared with many chemical sunscreens.
picks.con: Sunscreen only works when it is reapplied as directed on the label.
